The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. The satellite measure of heat stress, though, covers a longer period: from January 2023 through September 2025, bleaching-level heat stress extended across roughly 84.4% of the world’s reef area.

That is up from 68.2% during the 2014–2017 event. Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories.

The record is about the scale of reef area exposed to bleaching-level heat stress—not proof that every exposed reef bleached or died.
